description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PimReportSearchFilterParams, which extends FilterParams and implements ReportSearchFilterParams, encapsulating parameters such as reportId for search filtering within the OrangeHRM Pim plugin.

classes.name: PimReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for search filter parameters related to Pim reports, including a report ID.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID associated with this search filter.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the report ID for this search filter.
